When tokens are transferred, fees are collected by the contract. The swapAndLiquify function converts accumulated tokens to BNB and sends 2/3 to a hardcoded marketing address. The vulnerability allows the owner to extract value by setting maximum fees and triggering the swap mechanism.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank. 2. Set tax and liquidity fees to maximum (99%). 3. Create a victim address with tokens. 4. Trigger a transfer from victim to generate fees. 5. Call swapAndLiquify to convert fees to BNB. 6. The attacker profits from the BNB sent to marketing address (if attacker controls it) or through other extraction mechanisms.

Have victim transfer tokens (fees accumulate in contract). 5. Trigger swapAndLiquify by meeting the token threshold. 6. Check if attacker balance increased from the exploit.
